# Who configures what

Every setting of the [settings catalogue](../../core/application/service/setting/Catalogue.go), at
each level that may decide it, with what a writer needs there (configuration/model.md §4). At the
installation and a plan the writer is the operator (`admin:instance`); at a person's own level
the person alone. In a workspace, a hub and a collection the writer is a permission, carried by the
shipped roles named here and by any custom role given it - *People → Permissions* answers that for
one workspace, by person and place.

| Setting | Level | Writer needs | Shipped roles that carry it |
|---|---|---|---|
